verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at https://pipedream.com/llms.txt returning HTTP 200 with Connect-focused content. First-party evidence also describes a docs llms.txt that indexes OpenAPI specs, markdown (.md) versions of docs pages, and reference docs the vendor calls "AI-friendly", so an agent can be pointed at machine-oriented docs directly. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs, and the root llms.txt appears scoped to the Connect app marketplace rather than the full product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://pipedream.com/llms.txt # Pipedream Connect — App marketplace
the docs llms.txt lists it under "## OpenAPI Specs" together with a second Conduit API spec
The vendor changelog calls the reference "completely redesigned, interactive, AI-friendly documentation".
